description: Source code for ACPI (Advanced Configuration and Power Interface) handling in Zephyr OS, including initialization, device enumeration, resource management, and ACPI table parsing.

methods.name: acpi_init
methods.description: Initializes the ACPI subsystem, including loading tables and enabling hardware.

methods.name: check_init_status
methods.description: Checks if ACPI is initialized; if not, initializes it.

methods.name: notify_handler
methods.description: Handles ACPI notifications.

methods.name: install_handlers
methods.description: Installs global ACPI notify handlers.

methods.name: initialize_acpica
methods.description: Performs ACPI subsystem initialization, including loading tables and creating namespace.

methods.name: acpi_name_lookup
methods.description: Looks up an ACPI namespace node by name.

methods.name: acpi_evaluate_method
methods.description: Evaluates an ACPI method on a device.

methods.name: acpi_enable_pic_mode
methods.description: Enables PIC mode via ACPI method.

methods.name: dev_resource_enum_callback
methods.description: Callback for enumerating device resources.

methods.name: acpi_enum_devices
methods.description: Enumerates ACPI devices.

methods.name: acpi_early_init
methods.description: Performs early ACPI table initialization.

methods.name: acpi_current_resource_get
methods.description: Retrieves current resources for a device.

methods.name: acpi_possible_resource_get
methods.description: Retrieves possible resources for a device.

methods.name: acpi_current_resource_free
methods.description: Frees resources obtained from ACPI.

methods.name: acpi_resource_parse
methods.description: Parses an ACPI resource of a specific type.

methods.name: acpi_device_irq_get
methods.description: Gets IRQ resources for a device.

methods.name: acpi_device_mmio_get
methods.description: Gets MMIO resources for a device.

methods.name: acpi_device_get
methods.description: Retrieves an ACPI device by hardware ID and UID.

methods.name: acpi_device_by_index_get
methods.description: Retrieves an ACPI device by index.

methods.name: acpi_table_get
methods.description: Retrieves an ACPI table by signature and instance.

methods.name: acpi_get_subtable_entry_num
methods.description: Counts entries of a specific type in an ACPI subtable.

methods.name: acpi_madt_entry_get
methods.description: Retrieves MADT entries of a specific type.

methods.name: acpi_dmar_entry_get
methods.description: Retrieves DMAR entries of a specific type.

methods.name: acpi_dmar_ioapic_get
methods.description: Gets IOAPIC ID from DMAR table.

methods.name: acpi_drhd_get
methods.description: Retrieves DRHD (DMA Remapping Hardware Unit) entries.

methods.name: acpi_local_apic_get
methods.description: Gets local APIC information for a CPU.

methods.name: acpi_invoke_method
methods.description: Invokes an ACPI method with arguments.
